تستحرمون (form X)
# تَسْتَحْرِمُونَ (tastaḥrimūna) /tas.taħ.ri.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# تُسْتَحْرَمُونَ (tustaḥramūna) /tus.taħ.ra.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
